name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; descriptor accurately reflects body (computes the on-screen position of a combat speech bubble for one char). No Ghidra address residue in suffix. Both callers are combat speech-bubble animation, matching the 'combat_bubble' descriptor.
purpose: Compute the screen pixel position (x, y) of a combat speech bubble anchored to one runtime char's tile, adjusting for the char's facing direction and clamping so the bubble stays within the 320x200 screen.
logic_summary: rc = runtime_char_array[char_idx]. Base anchor: out[0]=x=(rc.pos_x - view_window_origin_x)*0x18 + 4; out[1]=y=(rc.pos_y - view_window_origin_y)*0x18. Then branch on facing = rc.sprite_state[1]: if facing < 2 (char faces down/right) place bubble ABOVE the char: new_y = y - 0x12; y = (new_y < 0) ? y+5 : new_y; if right edge overflows (x+0x6C > 0x13F) then x -= 0x56 and return. Else (facing >= 2, char faces up/left) place bubble BELOW: y += (y+0x25 < 200) ? 0x16 : 5; if left edge stays on-screen (x-0x56 >= 0) then x -= 0x58 and return. If neither edge-fix branch returned (bubble would overflow both sides), fall through and nudge x += 0x1C. Void return; results written through out_xy_ptr.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Output pointer to a 2-dword buffer that receives the bubble screen position: [0]=x (int32), [4]=y (int32). Caller fd2_animate_combat_speech_bubbles passes &pos_pairs[0] (0x53A30) for the defender bubble and &pos_pairs[2] (0x53A38) for the counter-attacker bubble.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic decompiler placeholder param_1, which does not reflect purpose; src already uses out_xy_ptr. Rename applied in Stage 2.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr selecting the combatant whose tile anchors the bubble. Caller passes defender_idx (first call) and attacker_idx (counter, second call).
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is generic placeholder param_2; src already uses char_idx, which reflects its use as a runtime_char array index. Rename applied in Stage 2.

returns.semantics: No return value. Results are written through out_xy_ptr: out[0]=x, out[4]=y (combat_speech_bubble_pos_pairs entry).

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct but terse: it noted only 'adjusting for facing direction and screen boundaries' without documenting the base-anchor formula, the above/below facing split, or the specific edge clamps.
notes: Two call sites, both in fd2_animate_combat_speech_bubbles @0x1EB05 (defender bubble at pos_pairs[0]/0x53A30 with defender_idx; counter-attacker bubble at pos_pairs[2]/0x53A38 with attacker_idx). The struct field rc->sprite_state[1] (facing) corresponds to the decompiled rt_char+3 (sprite_state base +0x02, [1] = +0x03); confirmed against runtime_char in types.h. Decompiled '< 200' vs src '<= 0xC7' (199), '0x13f < x+0x6c' vs src 'x+0x6C > 0x13F', '-1 < x-0x56' vs src 'x-0x56 >= 0' are all algebraically equivalent comparison rewrites, not logic changes. __CHK is the Watcom stack-probe/bounds intrinsic, not game logic. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with the refined src comment, so left untouched.
